tools.name: ncsx_latest
tools.description: Get the latest NCSX index levels (Composite / HY / IG) with daily & weekly changes, 90-day percentiles, as-of date, methodology version, DOI and data_status. Read data_status before quoting: "seed" means demo series, "verified" means observed market data.

tools.name: ncsx_levels
tools.description: Get the 90-trading-day daily level series for one NCSX index tier (composite | hy | ig).

tools.name: ncsx_bond
tools.description: Get the profile and 30-day spread path of one constituent bond by CUSIP (e.g. US21873SAC26).

tools.name: ncsx_constituents
tools.description: List all constituent bonds (issuer, coupon, maturity, rating, tier, spread) with identifier verification status.

tools.name: ncsx_attribution
tools.description: Get this week's index change attribution (which bonds moved the index, in bp).

tools.name: ncsx_methodology
tools.description: Get methodology metadata: version, DOI, license, formulas, data source licensing status.

tools.name: ncsx_weekly
tools.description: Get the latest weekly report snapshot (levels, weekly changes, attribution, citation string).
